seeded.title: Member can approve a change through the approver-only mutation
seeded.truth: The schema declares approveChange approver-only, but the resolver allows a member of the workspace to transition a pending change to APPROVED.
seeded.impact: A member can approve a synthetic operational change without the required approver role.
seeded.proof: As milo, approve chg-orbit-42 with a marker, then observe state APPROVED, approvedBy milo and the same marker; aria independently observes the audit event.

negative_controls.truth: milo cannot update workspace configuration because the approver role is enforced
cross-workspace reads and mutations return NOT_FOUND
milo cannot cancel a change requested by aria
GraphQL operations require a bearer token

expected_observations: JSON service index identifies GraphQL and JSON-RPC endpoints
Schema advertises a requiresRole(approver) directive on approveChange
Users and change requests expose workspace, role, ownership and state relationships
